I have had asthma for 25 years and have always been on repeat prescriptions for my inhalers, paying for two of each as prescribed. After moving to Cotham last year, I registered with The Family Practice. Without any explanation or consultation, they reduced my blue inhaler to one while still charging me for two.

This change has caused ongoing problems with managing my asthma. The prescription charge itself has not changed, so there is no justification for reducing the quantity supplied.
I have emailed the practice three times and raised the issue twice via the NHS app. I have received zero response. Despite this, I continue to be charged for medication I am not being given.
